meta.title: Domi Adiwijaya
meta.description: Istakshif majmu'at al-a'mal, al-ru'a al-taqniyya, wa al-mashari' al-mubtakira li Domi Adiwijaya, muhibb mutakhassis fi al-taqniyya wa al-homelab.

hero.blurb: Usammimu wa uqaddimu nuzuman mawthuqa. Min bunyat al-homelab ila al-automation bi-mustawa al-intaj, uhawwilu al-quyud al-muta'aqqida ila hulul rashiqa wa mutamassika.

about.lead: Yahduni al-hirs 'ala tahsin al-taqniyya bi-ma'na haqiqi, sawa'an fi homelab muhaakam aw bi-musaa'adat al-akhareen 'ala hall al-tahaddiyat al-waqi'iyya al-muta'aqqida.
about.p1: Ana Domi. Mundhu al-bidaya, hawwali al-fudul ila mumarasa munazzama li-tasmiym nuzum tahullu mushkilat muhimma fi al-'alam al-haqiqi.
about.p2: Al-homelab 'indi yu'addu bi'a murakkaza lil-bahth wa al-tatwir: ukhadi'u al-afkar li-ikhtibarat al-daght, thumma u'ashshiduha wa uhawwiluha ila intaj idha thabatat qiwamatuha.
about.p3: Fawqa al-tashkil wa al-automation, uwwaththiqu ma ata'allamuhu wa usharikuhu li-yatawajja al-akharun al-ta'aqud bisur'a akbar. Lahzat 'amal kulli shay' bikhiffa wa duqa hiya al-ghaya.

bullets.1: Bahth wa tatwir fi al-homelab, hallal mashakil baragmati

innovation.title: Ibtikar Taqni
innovation.description: Uqayyimu al-taqaniyat al-namiya wa u'arkhitu hululan rashiqa qabila lil-tawsi' li-mushkilat dhat athar.

homelab.title: Bahth wa Tatwir al-Homelab
homelab.description: Bi'a muhaakama ukhadi'u fiha al-afkar li-ikhtibarat al-daght, atashdiduha, thumma uhawwiluha ila intaj qabla muwajahat al-haraka al-haqiqiyya.

automation.title: Automation Awwalan
automation.description: Kullu 'amalin yu'adu marratayn yusbihu murashahan li-automation mawthuqa idempotent.

sharing.title: Musharaka al-Ma'rifa
sharing.description: Ulalakhkhisu al-durusa ila watha'iq, demo, wa muhadharat li-ta'jil al-ta'allum 'abr al-firaq.

skills.lead: Silsilat al-adawat allati a'tamid 'alaiha li-tasmiym, automation, wa tashghil nuzum tabqa rashiqa tahta al-haml wa qabilatan lil-tanabu' 'inda al-ikhtilal.

tail.title: La Tatawaqqaf 'an al-Ta'allum
tail.body: Al-taqniyya tatawarru kull yawm. Ujri tajarib mutawassila li-ikhtibar adawat jadida tahta al-daght, unaqqih mumarasati, wa uqaddim nata'ij afdal maqiyasan.

services.lead: Min al-bunya al-tahtiyya min al-bidaya ila al-nihaya hatta tilka al-mihna al-mu'andida allati turid izalatha, uqaddim hululan baragmatiyya da'ima.

homelab.title: Tarkib al-Homelab
homelab.description: Sammim wa ansher homelab muqassadan lil-ta'allum, al-tajriba, aw al-self-hosting, ma'a shabakat mutamassika, virtualization, wa khazan.

cloud.title: Hijra ila al-Cloud
cloud.description: Khatt baragmati mura' li-l-kulfa li-taqlil al-makhatir wa bina' mimar hadif fi al-cloud.

security.title: Tarkib al-Amn
security.description: Iqama dawabit amniyya baragmatiyya tuqallil al-makhatir biduni ibta' al-intajiyya.

automation.title: Automation Mawthuqa
automation.description: Iql al-'amal al-muta'awwid bi-automation qawi wa idempotent li-tatakarras 'alayhi thaqatan.

monitoring.title: Monitoring wa Tanbihat
monitoring.description: Ru'ya amaliyya wa inthar mubakkir 'abr al-nuzum qabl an yash'ur al-mustakhdimun bi-ayy athar.

data.title: Al-Bayanat wa al-Nusakh al-Ihtiyatiyya
data.description: Himayat al-bayanat al-hassasa bi-nusakh ihtiyatiyya murina wa isti'ada sari'a wa idarat 'umr al-bayanat.

tail.title: Turid Shay'an Mukhtalifan?
tail.body: Al-siyaqat takhtalif wa al-qawalib la tanasib da'iman. Qul li ma tahtajuh, wa sanusammim hallan yatalamu ma'a ahdafik, hududik, wa al-awqat.

contact.lead: Hal ladayka mubadara li-tashkiliha aw mushkila turidu tafkiikaha? Tawasal, as'aa li-fahm ahdafik wa rasm tariq baragmati li-l-mudaqqaq.

drop.title: Irsil li Risala
drop.body: Istadim al-namudhaj al-muqaran aw arsil bariidan iliktruniyan; kullu tariq yunasibuk. Aqra'u kulla risala.

form.message_ph: A'rd al-ahdaf, al-hudud, wa al-awqat bi-ikhtisar.

connect.title: Hayya Natawasal
connect.body: Sawa'an kuntu tufakkir fi tawthiq mafhum, tawsi'at nizam, aw talib ra'y thanin, sa'akunu sa'idan bi-al-musaa'ada wa taqdim khutuwat wadihah.

error404.p: Al-safha allati tabhathu 'anha ghayr mawjudah aw tam naqluha.
